title: W7 test -- projects-screen:587 fails intermittently at exactly 1.00364
description: Failed 2 of 8 wave-7 full-suite logs, both exactly 1.00364 (wants > 1.005), passes 5 of 5 alone. Cause inferred (timing); identical value unexplained. See VALIDATION.md open items. Test-only unless a real label-easing bug is found; do not weaken it.

review.note: Recorder sound: pre-move frames are all at or above peak, so only post-move frames can pass. Independently failed on a transition-stripped build (no ease frame between 1 and 1.04). repeat-each=5 passed; full suite passed. See REVIEW-small-fixes.md.

log.note: tests/projects-screen.spec.ts only (src untouched, nothing committed). Cause of 1.00364: the ease is cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1) over 120ms from 1.04; 1.00365 is exactly the 4th 60Hz frame (66.7ms), so the old fixed 30ms sample landed ~67ms late under load. Not an app bug. Fix: record transform on every rAF frame (1.5s recorder installed before mouse.move) and require a frame with 1 < scale < peak. Evidence: repeat-each=10 on 'eases its grow back': 10 passed; full projects-screen.spec.ts: 43 passed; doctored build with transitions stripped from built CSS (scratch dist-nt, port 1954): fails with 'no ease frame between 1 and 1.04: 1.04, 1, 1, ...'. Earlier runs in this session failed on the sampler starting late (all-1 frames), which is why the recorder now starts before the move.
